# ApexHive Labs — 5 Pure-Free MIT Tools & EvalShield Cloud Flagship

> Independent open-source engineering lab building 5 pure-free MIT developer & operations tools (MCP proxy & static linter, Base USDC verification rails, self-hosted SME ERP) plus 1 hosted cloud futures risk flagship (`evalshield-copilot`).

## 5 Pure-Free MIT Tools (#1-#5)
1. `slimmcp-proxy` (`v1.0.2`, MIT): Progressive-disclosure Meta-MCP proxy (`stdio`, `Streamable-HTTP`, `SSE`) in pure Node.js (`>=24`) cutting 60-tool `tools/list` schema overhead from 60,185 bytes (~15,047 tokens) to 1,286 bytes (~322 tokens) = 97.86% initial schema reduction (~737 tokens / ~95.1% net 1-turn savings including `discover_tools` + `inspect_tool_schema`), with BM25 search, secret redaction, and free RBAC/budget guardrails.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/slimmcp-proxy
   - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/slimmcp-proxy (`npx -y slimmcp-proxy --help`)
   - Official MCP Registry: https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers/io.github.apexhive-hq%2Fslimmcp-proxy/versions/latest
   - Glama Directory: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/apexhive-hq/slimmcp-proxy
2. `zerofiat-base-checkout-kit` (`v2.1.0`, MIT): Non-custodial Base Mainnet USDC (`eip155:8453`) verification rail on Cloudflare Workers with EOA (`EIP-191`) + Smart Wallet (`ERC-1271` / `EIP-6492`) verification and SQLite Durable Object atomic anti-replay lock (`TxClaimLockDO`).
   - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/zerofiat-base-checkout-kit
   - Live Reference Worker: https://zerofiat-base-checkout-kit.apexhive-hq.workers.dev
3. `web3-ops-automation-pack` (MIT): Cross-platform TypeScript (`Node.js >= 24`) and Python (`3.12+`) Base/Solana USDC verifiers, Playwright mock EIP-1193 checkout QA harness, and n8n webhook automation templates.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/web3-ops-automation-pack
4. `mcp-doctor` (`v1.0.1`, MIT): Lightweight static regex-based MCP security & context-tax CLI linter (`A-F` score grading, `--policy`, `--ci --min-score`, SARIF 2.1.0).
   - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/mcp-doctor
   - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/apexhive-mcp-doctor (`npx -y apexhive-mcp-doctor status`)
5. `open-center-os` (`v2.2.0`, MIT): Self-hostable multi-branch SME & education center ERP on `node:sqlite` with trilingual EN/繁中/簡中 UI, HMAC cookie + Bearer admin auth, locked CORS, POS cart, timetable, QR check-in, and unlimited free branches.
   - GitHub: https://github.com/apexhive-hq/open-center-os

## 1 Hosted Cloud Flagship (#6)
6. `evalshield-copilot` (`v3.0.2`, ApexHive Dual License — Solo 0 USDC Forever · Commercial Team 99 USDC / Enterprise 499 USDC): Human-in-the-loop cross-market futures & prop-firm risk shield covering Topstep, Apex, MFFU, FTMO (1&2-Step), and Tradeify across CME Futures (`ES/NQ/GC/CL`), Gold (`XAUUSD` rollover R-drag), FX, and Crypto Perps (`BTC/ETH/SOL`), with Cross-Account Anti-Hedge Portfolio Guard, Pre-Trade Thesis Journal (`node:sqlite` WAL), Hyperliquid/Polymarket 15s Brief, rolling multi-year macro blackout calendar, 25k-run Monte Carlo, and 1-click self-host `deploy/cloudflare-byo/` kit. Strictly read-only: zero broker API keys and zero automated order placement.
   - Hosted Cloud Flagship: https://evalshield-copilot.apexhive-hq.workers.dev/
   - GitHub (Dual License): https://github.com/apexhive-hq/evalshield-copilot

## Internal R&D Note
- `polymarket-paper`: Internal, strictly read-only `$0`-capital research collector using a SHA-256 hash-chained simulation ledger and Brier calibration benchmarks. Not a public commercial or custody product.

## Quick Start (Node.js >= 24)
```bash
npx -y slimmcp-proxy --help
npx -y slimmcp-proxy serve --config /path/to/mcp-servers.json
npx -y apexhive-mcp-doctor status
```
